title: Row and column clearing exposes the full algebraic norm degree cost

statement.quantifiers: Fixed positive real algebraic alpha!=1, F=Q(alpha) of degree d, integer b with b alpha integral, finitely many proposed rational approximants p_i/q_i and fixed weighted matrix parameters.
statement.assertion: A nonzero minor Delta becomes z=S Delta in O_F after exact row/column and common logarithm-denominator clearing; norm lower bound log|Delta|/(MH)>=-d(1-bbar)-(d E0+sum_other E_sigma)-o(1).
assumptions: Use the same rational approximants in every field embedding; arbitrary F approximants are not allowed.
Truncated logarithms G_i of fixed degree and Li=lcm(1,...,Ti-1); D_H=prod Li^floor(H/w_i).
Nonzero entry requires gamma>=beta coordinatewise; exact b,q clearing is accounted before norms.

inputs: Nonzero full-row field minor from interpolation, exact rational approximants, integral alpha clearing integer b.
outputs: An explicit nonzero algebraic integer, principal/conjugate size ledger and valid degree-charged lower bound.
interface.precision: Exact algebraic integrality and asymptotics after all finite parameters are fixed before H.
costs: Column b^((K-1)h)prod q_i^gamma and row prod q_i^-beta both charged; determinant M! counted.
Height/conjugate bounds affect onset/errors; exponent degree-only does not imply uniform effective constants.
Finite exact rank matrices and scalar parameter schedules do not certify the general argument.

proof_mechanism: Write each entry as D_H b^((K-1-j)h)(b alpha)^jh binom(gamma,beta)[t^s](1+t)^h prod(j p_i+q_i G_i)^(gamma_i-beta_i).
Check logarithm denominators and weighted degrees entrywise to establish integrality of z.
Bound all other conjugate determinants before applying the integer norm product.
Include S in every conjugate: its leading cost is multiplied by d.
Compare the principal determinant lower bound to the independently supplied analytic collision upper bound.
obstructions: A generic bounded-conjugate norm does not improve to degree-free clearing: Pell gives a precise counterexample.
General exponent2 would require new determinant-specific conjugate suppression at unchanged costs, or another route.
Supplementary matched-embedding2d/r is not a completed proof.

potential_uses.target: Number-field extensions of rational logarithm determinants
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Audit integral entries and every embedding before claiming that height or degree costs disappear.

review.source_reported: Source-scoped analytic derivations, independent reconstruction for counting/logarithm, and finite checks reported; Hamiltonian proof has source-reported review only; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
